welcome.title:
Your life,
well kept
welcome.body: A private place for your important documents, accounts, instructions and more. So you and the people you care about are prepared, today and tomorrow.

phone.title: Set up your account
phone.subtitle: Your phone number and WhatsApp will get you started. No email needed.
phone.signInSubtitle: Enter the number of your Keeplas account. We'll send you a code on WhatsApp.
phone.label: Phone number
phone.reassure: Your number identifies your account. Passkeys protect access.
phone.emailAccount: I signed up with an email
phone.accountExists: An account already uses this number. Sign in instead.
phone.noAccount: No account uses this number. Get started to create one.

verify.title: Verify your number
verify.body: We sent a code to your WhatsApp number {phone}.
verify.resent: We sent you a new code.
verify.note: We only use WhatsApp for notifications. Nothing from your vault is sent there.

codeErrors.wrongBody: Check the 6 digits in WhatsApp and try again. {count} tries left.
codeErrors.expiredBody: Codes work for 10 minutes. We can send you a new one.
codeErrors.tooManyBody: For your safety, sign-in is paused for this number. Try again in an hour.
codeErrors.notArrivingBody: Check that WhatsApp is set up on {phone}, then ask for a new code.

passkey.title: Create your passkey
passkey.body: Use Face ID or fingerprint to securely access your account. Your passkey stays on this device and never leaves it.
passkey.failedBody: The prompt closed before you finished. You need a passkey to keep your vault on this phone.
passkey.biometricsTitle: Turn on Face ID or a fingerprint
passkey.biometricsBody: Keeplas uses your phone's screen lock to protect your vault. Set one up in Settings, then come back.

vault.title: Create your private vault
vault.body: Your vault is created securely on this device and encrypted. Only you can access it.
vault.note: Your vault is encrypted on this device with your passkey. No one else can access it.

contacts.title: Add trust contacts
contacts.body: Invite up to 3 people you trust. Any 2 can help you recover your account and confirm a death. This role does not give them access to your files.
contacts.warning: Without contacts or a recovery kit, losing every device and passkey may lock you out.
contacts.later: Inviting contacts comes in the next update. You'll find it under People.

setupDone.title: Setup complete
setupDone.body: Your account is ready. Your information is safe and ready for tomorrow.
setupDone.contactsBody: Invite up to 3 people. 2 can help you recover your account and confirm a death.
setupDone.kitBody: Save a kit to regain access if you lose all your devices and passkey.

kit.title: Your recovery kit
kit.body: Write these 24 words down, in order, and keep them somewhere safe. With them you can open your vault if you lose this phone.
kit.warning: Anyone with these words and access to your phone number can open your vault. Never share them.
kit.unavailable: Your kit can only be shown while you set up this phone. A new kit can be created from Privacy and security in the next update.

oneWay.title: If you lose this phone, you lose your vault
oneWay.body: Right now this phone is your only way in. Keeplas can't read your vault, so we can't restore it for you.
oneWay.understand: I understand I could lose everything if I lose this phone

attestation.title: Keeplas can't run on this device
attestation.body: To protect what you store, Keeplas only works on devices that pass a standard security check. This one didn't, so we can't create your account here.
attestation.hint: This often happens on devices that are modified (rooted or jailbroken), running a test build, or emulated. Try again on another phone.
attestation.whyBody: The check proves the request comes from the genuine Keeplas app on a real phone, so no one can create accounts with a fake app.

unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.body: Face ID or fingerprint signs you in and unlocks your vault.
unlock.failed: We couldn't unlock your vault. Try again.

recoveryKit.title: Open your vault with your kit
recoveryKit.body: This phone doesn't hold your vault key yet. Type the 24 words of your recovery kit, separated by spaces.
recoveryKit.invalid: These words don't open your vault. Check each word and their order.

home.subtitle: Your important information is safe and ready for tomorrow.
home.inboxBody: Items to sort will show up here
home.recentEmpty: Your vault list arrives with capture in the next update.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your plan, storage and preferences.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.subtitle: Manage how you access your vault and protect your information.
privacy.passkeyBody: Secure sign-in with Face ID or fingerprint.
privacy.pinBody: Add a PIN after biometrics for extra security.
privacy.kitBody: Prepare a way back in if you lose access.
privacy.devicesBody: Manage the devices connected to your account.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every device and browser that can open your vault.
devices.removeBody: It's signed out and can't sign in again without a new link from this phone.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: Open Keeplas on your computer, then scan its QR code.
scan.manualLabel: Paste the link shown under the QR code
scan.invalidBody: Scan the QR code shown by Keeplas on your computer.
scan.expiredBody: Codes work for 2 minutes. Refresh the page on your computer to get a new one.
scan.cameraOffBody: Allow the camera to scan QR codes and capture documents.

linkBrowser.title: Link this browser?
linkBrowser.body: A device is requesting access to your Keeplas account.
linkBrowser.warning: Approve only if this is your computer.

connected.title: Browser connected
connected.body: Keeplas is now linked to this browser.
connected.notified: Your other devices have been notified. A notification was sent to all your connected devices.

blocked.title: We stopped this link
blocked.body: The key in this QR code doesn't match your account. Nothing was shared and no browser was linked.
blocked.warning: This can mean someone between you and Keeplas is trying to read your vault. Don't retry on this network.
blocked.whatBody: The QR code holds a fingerprint of your computer's key. Keeplas sent a different key, so sharing your vault with it could hand it to someone else. We stopped before anything left this phone.

newDevice.title: New device detected
newDevice.body: A sign-in to your account was detected on {device}.

notMe.title: Let's lock this down
notMe.body: We'll cut off {device} ({time}) right now. Here's what happens when you continue:
notMe.removeBody: It's signed out and can't sign in again.
notMe.sessionsBody: Any open vault on that device closes at once.
notMe.rotateBody: Your vault is re-encrypted. Other devices will ask you to unlock again.
notMe.note: Your trusted contacts are not alerted. You can review who has access right after.

secured.title: Your account is secure
secured.body: The unknown device has no access anymore. Here's what we did:
secured.keysPendingBody: Finish it from a computer with your recovery kit. This phone will do it in the next update.
secured.note: Your other devices will ask you to unlock again. That's expected.

migration.title: Move your account to your phone
migration.body: Keeplas now signs you in with your phone and a passkey, no password. It takes about 3 minutes.
migration.passkeyStepBody: Face ID or fingerprint replaces your password
migration.appStepBody: Your vault moves to this phone
migration.offStepBody: We do it for you once steps 1 to 4 are done
migration.note: Your vault and trusted contacts stay exactly as they are.
migration.doneBody: Your account now lives on this phone. Your old password no longer works anywhere.
migration.doneNote: On a computer, sign in by scanning a QR code with this phone.

email.title: Sign in with your email
email.body: For accounts created on the web. You'll then move your account to this phone.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.body: Accepting invitations arrives in the next update of the app. Keep this link: you'll be able to accept it then.

selfTest.title: Crypto self-test
selfTest.body: Runs the shared test vectors on this device's native crypto engines.
